notes.title: Progress Update May 2021
notes.notes:
Thanks all for your interest in A Couple of Cubes! We really appreciate everyone's support in helping us create a better game and a stronger community. 

Developing A Couple of Cubes has been so much fun for the team and continues to inspire us in new ways every day. The possibilities are endless with our art style and mechanics and some of the things we have come up with are starting to get really exciting! You can see a teaser for one of our crazy set pieces below:

[previewyoutube=62bPy-HUIyo;full][/previewyoutube]

We're overjoyed to get the chance to work with the immensely talented Adventure Shop on this project and his music brings yet another level of quality to our riveting adventure of a game. 

We have had a lot of great feedback from our demo and it has really benefited the development as it has allowed us to understand what people love about the game. The team have implemented so many changes over the past couple of months that the game is almost completely redesigned from our initial demo. We are really happy with how the game is coming along and can't wait to share more!

If you'd like to follow along more closely with the development of the game, follow us on Twitter @SilentYetiGames.
